narrative.details:
Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.

Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.
narrative.objectives: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>Yes, I can feel it working.  I will soon be able to travel.You have done me a great favor, Saixgone.
narrative.requestItemsText: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
